CDK 0.18.2 exposes `mnemonicToEntropy()` in the FFI, which validates the full BIP39 mnemonic including the checksum. That can replace the word-list-only check before `wipeDatabase` / `wallet_mnemonic` / `DeviceRecoveryBackup` are touched.

The per-field word-list check can stay for UI feedback, but the final validation before a destructive restore should call CDK.
